en.headline: Housing bureau logs over 73,600 basic-housing applications
en.dek: Winnie Ho told lawmakers the register has drawn more than 73,600 applications, with only 14 Home Ownership Scheme flats among the units logged.
body: Secretary for Housing Winnie Ho said on Monday that the basic-housing registration scheme has drawn a strong response, with more than 73,600 applications already lodged for subdivided units.

Speaking at a Legislative Council housing panel briefing, Ho said more than 20,000 residential units have been registered so far, and only 14 of them are Home Ownership Scheme flats. She said the bureau would keep a close watch. She repeated that letting an HOS flat before the premium is paid is unlawful, and that even after the premium is paid the flats have structural limits, including the common stacked kitchen-and-toilet layout, which cannot simply be removed, and window openings that are constrained by approved plans.

On the five-year plan's proposed 4:3:3 split of public rental, subsidised sale and private housing over the next decade, Ho said the old public-housing mix of 70:30, once private flats were counted, worked out closer to 5:2:3 and left the middle too thin. She said the government wants to move public housing toward a 60:40 split and enlarge the subsidised-sale share so the ownership ladder stays fluid.

Ho also addressed the Wang Fuk Court buyout. The deadline for owners to sign sale agreements falls next Thursday. She said owners who intend to complete a deal but miss the deadline for reasons outside their control, such as sudden serious illness and hospital admission, would be given leeway and help. Owners who refuse to communicate or to sign would be treated as declining the offer, she said, and the agreement would end. She did not rule out later legislation.

zh.headline: 何永賢：簡樸房登記已接逾7.3萬宗申請
zh.dek: 房屋局局長何永賢在立法會表示，簡樸房登記至今收到逾73600宗申請，已登記的二萬多個單位中居屋只佔14個。
body: 房屋局局長何永賢星期一在立法會房屋事務委員會政策簡報會上說，簡樸房登記制度反應理想，至今已收到逾73600宗分間單位登記申請。
何永賢說，目前已登記的二萬多個住宅單位中，居屋只佔14個，屬相當少數，局方會密切留意。她重申，未補地價出租居屋屬違法；即使已補地價，居屋亦有結構限制，普遍採用的「立體廚廁」不可隨意拆除，在外牆開窗作採光或通風亦受圖則限制。
對於五年規劃提出未來十年公屋、資助房屋及私樓供應比例為「4：3：3」，何永賢解釋，以往公營房屋維持「七三比」時，若計入私樓，整體比例實為「5：2：3」，中間階層比例偏輕。當局希望把公營房屋逐步調整為「六四比」，做大資助出售房屋比例，穩定中間層級，保持置業階梯的流動性。
宏福苑業主完成簽署買賣協議的期限將於下周四屆滿。何永賢說，有誠意完成交易、但因突發重病入院等不可控制原因未能在期限前簽約的業主，當局會體諒並盡力協調。她強調，若業主無意溝通或拒絕簽署文件，將被視為不接受收購計劃，買賣協議會終止，當局不排除日後以立法方式處理。
